info.title: Phone Integration API
info.description:
Connects epilot to phone systems. Resolves the epilot customers (Contacts)
behind phone numbers and other contact identifiers, many at once, so the
epilot 360 phone can show callers and call history by name.

tags.name: manager
tags.description:
Phone manager (epilot 360 control center): which organization members hold the phone and the
telephony-provider user behind each of them. Caller must hold `phone:manage` in the organization.

tags.name: operator
tags.description:
Provider setup per organization, run by epilot CS from the admin portal. Platform operators only
(admin-portal internal-auth token in an allowed group), never customer tokens.

get.description:
Resolves up to 50 identifiers to epilot customers (Contacts) in one
request — for example every number in an agent's call history.

Each identifier is an exact key of a Contact: its entity `id`, its
`customer_number`, its `external_id`, one of its `email` addresses or
one of its `phone` numbers. Repeat a parameter to pass several values,
and combine parameters freely. Phone numbers are normalized on the
server, so E.164, national and formatted forms of one number match the
same contact; the other identifiers match exactly, ignoring case and
surrounding whitespace.

Every distinct identifier gets its own result, so one unknown or
ambiguous identifier never fails the others. Results are ordered by
parameter (`id`, `customer_number`, `external_id`, `phone_number`,
`email`), then as sent; match them by `identifier`.

The search runs with the caller's token: the organization and the
permissions applied are the caller's own, as for entity search.

parameters.name: external_id
parameters.description: Contact external id, as set by an integration

parameters.name: phone_number
parameters.description: Phone number in E.164 (+4917…), national (017…) or a formatted form

parameters.name: x-trace-id
parameters.description: Correlation id; echoed on the response

x-trace-id.description: Correlation id (echoed if supplied, otherwise generated)

400.description: No identifier, more than 50, or a blank one

401.description: Missing, invalid, or downstream-rejected epilot bearer token

403.description: Caller is not permitted to search Contacts

get.description:
Whether the caller's organization is ready for phone agents: the telephony provider tenant
exists and is configured. The control center shows a "not set up" state when `ready` is false.
Requires `phone:manage`.

Organization members who hold the phone (`phone:use`), each joined with the provider user behind
them. Requires `phone:manage`.

post.description:
Gives an organization member the phone. In order: the member is verified with user-api, their
pairwise subject for the provider is read from identity-api, the provider user is created (or
found) bound to that subject with the `agent` role, and only then the `phone_agent` role
(`phone:use`) is assigned in epilot. Idempotent: an already assigned member answers `200`.
Requires `phone:manage`.

200.description: The member already held the phone

201.description: The member now holds the phone

404.description: The user is not an active member of the organization (code `member_not_found`)

delete.description:
Takes the phone away from a member: the `phone_agent` role is removed first, then the provider
user is deactivated (never deleted: call history keeps referring to it). Requires `phone:manage`.

204.description: The member no longer holds the phone

404.description: The member does not hold the phone (code `agent_not_found`)

502.description:
The role was removed but the provider user could not be deactivated (code `provider_error`);
removing again retries the deactivation.

get.description:
One snapshot of the organization's live phone state for the control center's Overview: agent
presence counters and per-queue health (waiting calls, longest wait, eligible vs available
agents). Read from the provider on every call (no caching); the control center polls it about
every 20 seconds. Requires `phone:manage`.

409.description: The organization is not set up for the phone (code `not_set_up`)

get.description:
The organization's phone agents with their live phone status, their skills (as the phone system
holds them) and the queues they can take calls from. Agents that are epilot phone agents carry
the epilot `user_id`. Queue eligibility is derived from every queue's routing steps (skills and
people). The control center filters and searches this list client-side and polls it about every
20 seconds. Requires `phone:manage`.

200.description: The organization's agents with live state

409.description: The organization is not set up for the phone (code `not_set_up`)

put.description:
Sets an agent's skills and direct queue membership (full sets, not deltas), in this order:
1. Skills: the agent's skills in the phone system are replaced by `skills`, so the phone system
   routes on them right away. The phone system is the source of truth for phone skills; they are
   independent of the skills in epilot's Access Management.
2. Direct queue membership: each listed queue gets the agent in its epilot-managed routing step
   (created on first use, lowest precedence, never touching the organization's own routing in
   the phone system); every other queue's epilot-managed step drops the agent. Eligibility
   through the phone system's own routing is not changed (`locked`).
Idempotent; a failure part-way answers `502` and repeating the call completes it. Requires
`phone:manage`.

200.description: The agent's skills and queue eligibility after the change

409.description: The organization is not set up for the phone (code `not_set_up`)

post.description:
The routing impact of `setAgentRouting` with the same body, without changing anything: the
queues the agent can take calls from now (as the phone system routes today) and after the
change, what is added and removed, the queues that would lose their last available agent, and
the queues the agent stays in through the phone system's own routing. Requires `phone:manage`.

409.description: The organization is not set up for the phone (code `not_set_up`)

get.description:
The organization's queues with live demand (waiting calls, longest wait), staffing (eligible
vs available agents), derived health and who can take their calls: the routing steps in the
order the phone system tries them, each naming skills and people. Routing is read-only in the
control center except the epilot-managed step that `setAgentRouting` maintains. Polled about
every 20 seconds. Requires `phone:manage`.

409.description: The organization is not set up for the phone (code `not_set_up`)

get.description:
One queue for the control center's queue drawer: the overview fields plus the agents currently
eligible for it (with live status and how they are eligible) and the calls waiting in it.
Requires `phone:manage`.

409.description: The organization is not set up for the phone (code `not_set_up`)

get.description:
Inbound call outcomes for a period, from the provider's call reporting: how many inbound calls
there were, how many an agent handled (bridged) and how many ended without an agent (abandoned
or failed), plus the inbound total of the period of the same length just before, for the
trend. The window is at most 31 days. Requires `phone:manage`.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the period (inclusive), RFC 3339 with an offset

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the period (exclusive), RFC 3339 with an offset

200.description: The call outcomes of the period

409.description: The organization is not set up for the phone (code `not_set_up`)

get.description:
Every organization that has a telephony provider tenant, for the admin portal's overview: the
provider's sub-accounts (one per organization, keyed by the organization id) joined with this
service's setup record. `ready` follows getManagerStatus: an organization whose tenant was created
by hand, outside `setupProvider`, has no record and is not ready until the setup runs once.
Sorted by organization id; not paged (one tenant per organization, a few hundred at most).
What has been set up at the telephony provider for this organization.

post.description:
Prepares the telephony provider for an organization, idempotently and in order: the provider
tenant (Babelforce sub-account keyed by the organization id), its SCIM configuration with role
management on, and its SSO configuration pointing at the identity-api client given here. The
client secret is forwarded to the provider and never stored by this service. Re-running updates
the SSO configuration (new client or rotated secret) and leaves the rest untouched.

200.description: Provider setup state after the run

409.description: The provider refused, for example the account name is taken (code `provider_conflict`)

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed or fails validation

Forbidden.description: The caller lacks the required permission

BadGateway.description:
A dependency failed: the telephony provider could not be reached or answered unexpectedly (code
`provider_error`, with the provider's request id when it sent one), or identity-api is
temporarily unavailable (code `identity_unavailable`). Retrying is safe.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The operator's admin-portal groups could not be checked right now; retry

OperatorAuth.description:
Internal-auth bearer token minted for an epilot admin-portal user in an allowed group (same
policy as identity-api's operator API). Customer organization bearers are never accepted.

reasons.description: Why the organization is not ready (empty when ready)

status.description:
`active`: holds the phone and has an enabled provider user. `pending`: assigned in epilot but
the provider user is not activated yet. `disabled`: provider user disabled. `missing_provider`:
holds `phone:use` but no provider user is bound (assign again to repair). `missing_role`:
assigned here, but the `phone_agent` role (`phone:use`) was removed elsewhere, e.g. in the
users and permissions settings (assign again to restore it, or remove to deactivate the
provider user).

provider_user_id.description: The provider's id of the bound user

assigned_by.description: epilot user id of the manager who assigned the phone

user_id.description: epilot user id of an active member of the caller's organization

tenant.description: The provider tenant for this organization (null until created)

identity_client_id.description: The identity-api client the tenant's SSO configuration points at

last_setup_by.description: Admin-portal operator (email) who last ran the setup

ProviderSetupSummary.description: One organization's provider setup, as listed in the overview (no live SCIM or SSO reads).

org_id.description: epilot organization id (the provider tenant's org key)

ready.description: Phone agents can be assigned (same rule as getManagerStatus)

setup_recorded.description:
`setupProvider` has run for this organization at least once. `false` for a tenant created by
hand at the provider: run the setup once to record it.

id.description: The provider's tenant id (Babelforce sub-account id)

sso_identity_client_id.description: The identity-api client the recorded SSO configuration points at

last_setup_by.description: The operator who last ran the setup (email)

updated_at.description: When the setup record last changed

account_name.description:
Provider tenant name, unique across the provider (3 to 100 characters). Required the first
time (`400` with code `account_name_required` without it); ignored once the tenant exists.

identity_client_id.description: identity-api client registered for the provider (its partner application for this stage)

identity_client_secret.description: The client's current secret, forwarded to the provider's SSO configuration and never stored

status.description:
- `found` — exactly one contact has the identifier; see `customer`
- `not_found` — no contact the caller may see has it
- `ambiguous` — several contacts share it; none is chosen
- `invalid` — not a usable identifier (a phone number that does
  not parse), so nothing was searched
- `error` — the search for this identifier failed; try again

id.description: epilot entity id of the customer (Contact)

name.description: The contact's title, else its first and last name; null when it has neither

customer_number.description: Omitted when the contact has none

AgentState.description:
The agent's live line state as the provider reports it, plus `offline` for an agent whose
presence is not available (not signed in or on a busy presence) and `unknown` when the
provider gives no state. `in_call` covers ringing-to-bridged; `wrap_up` is the post-call time.

AgentPresence.description: The provider presence the agent has selected (e.g. Available, Break, Meeting)

available.description: Whether this presence lets the agent take calls

Skill.description:
A skill as the phone system holds it (Babelforce: an agent tag). epilot's convention for skills is
`<skill category>:<label>` (e.g. `language:german`), which the control center shows as
"Category · Label"; a skill without a colon has no category.

PersonRef.description: An agent as a routing step names them

user_id.description: The epilot user id, when the agent is an epilot phone agent

AgentQueueEligibility.description: A queue an agent can take calls from, and why

skills.description: The agent's skills that make the queue route to them (empty unless `via` has `skill`)

locked.description:
The phone system's own routing names the agent (`via` has `routing`), so changing skills or
direct membership cannot remove the queue; the control center shows it checked and disabled.

user_id.description: The epilot user id, when the agent is an epilot phone agent (matched by email)

enabled.description: Whether the phone system routes queue calls to this agent at all

display_status.description: The phone system's human-readable status label

skills.description: The agent's skills as the phone system holds them (the source of truth for phone routing)

queues.description: Queues the agent can take calls from, derived from every queue's routing steps

current_call.description: The call the agent is on, when the phone system reports one

LiveAgentCounters.description: Presence counters over the organization's agents

online.description: Agents on an available presence, i.e. everyone not offline (available + on call + wrap-up + other busy line states)

QueueHealth.description:
`at_risk`: calls are waiting and no eligible agent is available. `healthy`: at least one
eligible agent is available. `quiet`: nothing waiting and nobody available.

QueueLive.description: Live demand and staffing of one queue

waiting.description: Calls waiting in the queue right now

longest_wait_seconds.description: How long the longest-waiting call has waited; absent when nothing waits

eligible.description: Agents the queue's routing steps resolve to

available.description: Eligible agents whose state is `available` right now

longest_wait_seconds.description: The longest wait across all queues; absent when nothing waits

QueueRoutingStep.description:
One step of who can take a queue's calls, in the order the phone system tries them. A step
offers calls to the people it names and to everyone with any of its skills. Teams set up in the
phone system appear as the people they contain. The epilot-managed step holds the people added
from the control center; every other step is the organization's own routing, read-only here.

skills.description: Skills the step routes on (anyone with any of them)

people.description: People the step names, directly or through a team set up in the phone system

managed_by_epilot.description: The step `setAgentRouting` maintains; the only one the control center writes

numbers.description: Service numbers routed into this queue, when the phone system makes that derivable

routing.description: Who can take the queue's calls, in the order the phone system tries them

EligibleAgent.description: An agent who can take the queue's calls, with live status

skills.description: The agent's skills that make the queue route to them (empty unless `via` has `skill`)

from_masked.description: The caller's number with all but the last four digits hidden

skills.description: The agent's skills in the phone system (full set, not a delta); at most 200

queue_ids.description: The queues the agent is directly in, through the epilot-managed step (full set); at most 200

before.description: Queues the agent can take calls from now, as the phone system routes today

coverage_lost.description: Removed queues where this agent is currently the only available eligible agent

locked.description: Queues the agent stays in through the phone system's own routing, which this call cannot remove

handled_by_agent.description: Inbound calls bridged to an agent

abandoned_or_failed.description: Inbound calls that ended without reaching an agent

previous_period.description:
The same window shifted back by whole days (its length rounded up to days), for the trend: a
running "today" compares with yesterday up to the same time, "last 7 days" with the 7 days before

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, when the operation defines one.
